subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value:
TWO REFUTATIONS AND THE HALF THAT SURVIVES, on the callee-saved numbering rule the run-45 tool queue asked to be written down as `loaded-local outranks param-copy-local outranks direct-param`.

REFUTATION 1, THE DISPATCH PREMISE. The queue item states `3 sightings across CT/CL/SS reports, NO record exists under any phrasing`. A record exists: claim.law.CT_a-saved-parameter-numbers-below-the-locals-until-you-give-it-a-declared-copy.20260903.v1, accepted the same day, whose body already states the ordering as `width class first, then ORIGIN class (param-copy vs loaded), then declaration order`, and which attempt.SS_healthmeterstart-pool-struct-member-hoists-into-a-callee-saved-register.20260903.v1 cites BY ID in its own hypothesis. `gdlmem.py search "loaded local parameter copy"` returns it first. Writing the mandated law would have produced a second copy of a discriminator that already ships, which is the failure mode claim.law.T10_a-second-copy-of-a-discriminator-answers-the-same-question-differently.20260903.v1 names.

REFUTATION 2, AND IT IS THE IMPORTANT ONE: THE TARGET OF THE FLAGSHIP FUNCTION INVERTS THE MANDATED ORDER. Measured at 7daa12caf, zero builds, `python tools/gdl/fnasm.py game/ui/screensaver print_n_of_m 0x18:0x64 --raw --diff`. The retail stream emits, in order, `20: addi r26,r5,0` (the `m` parameter's copy), `24: addi r31,r7,0` (the `nd` copy of the `node` parameter), `50: lwz r29,536(r3)`, `58: lwz r30,548(r3)`, `5c: lwz r27,552(r3)`, `60: add r28,r6,r0`. RETAIL GIVES THE PARAM-COPY LOCAL r31, THE TOP OF THE BANK, ABOVE ALL FOUR LOADED/COMPUTED LOCALS -- and retail is MWCC output under these same cflags. Our stream emits `24: addi r30,r7,0` and `58: lwz r31,548(r3)`, i.e. the loaded local above the copy local. So `loaded outranks copy` is a description of OUR build's behaviour on ONE pair, and the SAME COMPILER produces the opposite order in the SAME FUNCTION. It is the residual itself, not a law: banking it would have written the bug down as the rule and closed the axis the residual lives on.

WHAT THE THREE SIGHTINGS ACTUALLY SUPPORT.
(a) SURVIVES, three sightings, no counterexample: a parameter used DIRECTLY -- never assigned to a declared local -- has its entry copy at the BOTTOM of the save set, below every local. Retail's `m` copy is `addi r26,r5,0` at the bottom in both streams; attempt.CL_print-n-of-m-a-loaded-local-outranks-a-parameter-copy-local.20260903.v2's probe state, which deleted `u32 nd;` and passed `node` directly, moved that copy to `addi r27,r7,0`, the bottom of the remaining bank, and REGRESSED real 16 -> 32; and the CT law's own measurement is the third.
(b) SURVIVES: assigning a parameter to a DECLARED LOCAL promotes it out of the bottom band at no instruction cost (MWCC emits the same single `addi rD,rParam,0` either way). Retail's r31 for `nd` is exactly what that promotion produces, which is why the CT law reads the target's assignment as evidence about the retail SOURCE. This is the half SS_healthmeterstart cites as a lever, and it is undisturbed.
(c) REFUTED as stated: that param-copy and loaded locals sit in two hard bands that `no further reordering will ever move past each other`. The CT law's evidence for it is that retyping `u32 nd` to `s32 nd` and swapping the two declarations both returned NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL against object digest 38009029928d. That is evidence that DECLARATION ORDER AND DECLARATION TYPE ARE DEAD LEVERS FOR THIS PAIR -- which is what those two probes measured -- and it is not evidence of a band; the inference from two dead levers to `no further reordering will EVER move them` is the over-reach, and the target bytes are its counterexample.

WHAT IS THEREFORE OPEN, and it is a source lane's item, not a postprocessor one: something OTHER than declaration order, declaration type, statement position and local existence decides which of a param-copy local and a memory-loaded local takes the higher callee-saved number, because all four of those are separately measured dead on this pair (the four probed_form axes in attempt.CL_print-n-of-m-a-loaded-local-outranks-a-parameter-copy-local.20260903.v2 and attempt.CT_print-n-of-m-param-copy-local-numbering.20260903.v1) while the target demonstrates the other order is reachable. The CL record's own next-step hypothesis -- change the NATURE of the arrH[].d definition so it is not a memory load that survives the two calls -- remains the untried direction, and it is now the only one with a live counterexample behind it.

STATUS OF THE FUNCTION. print_n_of_m is pinned as of run 45 (`copy_register_fields`, 8 raw differing words of 68 insns, provenance cited), so it is EQUIVALENT-counted, and under the USER's promotion-backlog directive this refutation is what keeps its promotion axis open rather than closed by a law that said the axis could not exist.
